item.title: RINGO STARR Slams ROGER DALTREY Over Firing Of Son: 'Never Liked How That Little Man Runs The Band'
item.description: Zak Starkey didn’t bother hiding his disappointment after being pushed out of The Who, a gig he held for nearly 30 years as the band’s live drummer. It all unraveled after a messy show at the Royal Albert Hall earlier this year, which ultimately triggered the official announcement of his departure in April.
